summary: Q&A Mode TUI/CLI surfaces progress - interactive fallback + native preference (Epic #139 / Feature #151 slice)

entries.surface: gh plate qanda CLI (fallback TUI path)
entries.migration_impact: Direct `gh plate qanda --record N` now supports interactive prompting (basic multi-line TUI fallback) when no --answer provided. Primary Copilot CLI path continues to prefer native host forms (enforced in guidance/persona per Design #144). No breaking changes to JSON or existing flags.
entries.agent_notes: In Copilot CLI (primary): always prefer native interactive primitives (forms, prompts) - never launch custom TUI unless native insufficient. Fallback `gh plate qanda` provides the interactive path for direct use + scripting. Blocking creation (#147) and resumption (#148) fully wired. See QANDA_CURIOSITY_GUIDANCE for decision tree. GIF evidence and richer widgets in follow-ups.
